item.title: How to dine with diabetes; Food Skills class offered by University of Missouri Extension
Prairie Home Booster Club announces winners
item.description: Congratulations to the winners of the second annual Booster Club cornhole tournament, Chris and Emilee Gann. Second place winners went to Jackson Pitts and Wyatt Case, while third place went to Cam Moore and William Stoneking. There was also a raffle for the cornhole boards and the winner of that was Kassandra Thomsen. Congratulations to all winners. Because of the community generosity the Booster Club was able to raise $300.00.

item.title: Bunceton Lions to host annual fish fry
item.description: Bunceton Lions Club will have their annual Eye Tissue Fish Fry on March 15th serving from 11:00 AM until 1:30 PM. On the menu is fish, fried potatoes, baked beans, cole slaw, potato salad, and your choice of desserts. Tickets are being sold by Lions’ Club members at $15 for adult tickets in advance or it will cost $18 at the door. Children ages 6 to 12 can eat for $7 and children ages 5 and under get to eat for free.
